Make annotation for miRNAs
```{r}

  mutate(plant = ifelse(id %in% names(mature_plant), "plant", "nonplant"),
         known = ifelse(id %in% mature_known, "known",
```

**We remove 3 samples of lower quality `PabK14-03SM_SR1`, `PabK14-03RO_SR2` and `Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1` that have clean unique reads less than 20,000 reads per sample. Please refer to post_miRDP2_BioQA report for plots.**

# Prepare data

Here we filter for SE samples
```{r}
lowQual <- c("PabK14-03SM_SR1","PabK14-03RO_SR2","Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1")
sel <- setdiff(samples$sampleName[samples$Dataset == "SE"],lowQual)
samples <- samples[samples$sampleName %in% sel,]
```

Make annotations
```{r}
annotCol <- samples %>% 
  dplyr::select(sampleName,StageType) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("sampleName")

anncol[["StageType"]] <- anncol[["StageType"]][unique(samples$StageType)]
```

The comparison will be made between adjacent stages SE_1 vs SE_2, SE_2 vs SE_3, and so on. All comparisons are as follow
```{r}
comp <- list(
  "SE2_vs_SE1" = list(treatment = "SE_2", control = "SE_1"),
  "SE3_vs_SE2" = list(treatment = "SE_3", control = "SE_2"),
  "SE4_vs_SE3" = list(treatment = "SE_4", control = "SE_3"),
  "SE5_vs_SE4" = list(treatment = "SE_5", control = "SE_4"),
  "SE6_vs_SE5" = list(treatment = "SE_6", control = "SE_5"))#,
#  "SE7_vs_SE6" = list(treatment = "SE_7", control = "SE_6"),
#  "SE8_vs_SE7" = list(treatment = "SE_8", control = "SE_7"))
knitr::kable(bind_rows(comp, .id = "comparison"))
```

# DEseq2 with 1st-tier predicted miRNAs

collapse all reads from second tier to Unaligned
```{r}
kept <- intersect(unique(c(names(mature_plant),mature_known,mature_variant)),read_lines(here("data/analysis/results/repChecked.txt")))

countk <- read_tsv(here("data/analysis/results/bowtie/count_DE.txt"), show_col_types = F) %>%
  split(., .$Gene_id %in% kept) %>% 
  imap(function(d,n){
    if(!as.logical(n)){
      #print(colSums(d[,-1]))
      dat <- data.frame(Unaligned = colSums(d[,-1])) %>% 
        t() %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>% 
        rownames_to_column("Gene_id")
      return(dat) } else { return(d) }
  }) %>% 
  bind_rows() %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene_id") %>%
  setNames(gsub("_count","",basename(colnames(.)))) %>%
  as.matrix() %>% 
  .[, samples$sample] 
```

Make dds object and normalize
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData=countk[,samples$sample], colData=samples, design = ~ StageType) %>% suppressWarnings()
colnames(dds) <- dds$sampleName

dds <- estimateSizeFactors(dds) %>% 
  suppressMessages()

vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds, blind=TRUE)
vst <- assay(vsd)
vst <- vst - min(vst)

boxplot(split(t(sizeFactors(dds)),dds$StageType),las=2,
        main="Sequencing libraries size factor by Stage")
```

## DE results and violin plots

Here I will loop over all comparisons. The results will be filtered based on a FDR threshold of 0.01 and a minimum log2FC of 0.5.
````{r, message=FALSE}
resultsList <- map(comp, function(c){
  dds$StageType <- relevel(dds$StageType, ref = c[["control"]])
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast=c("StageType",c[["treatment"]],c[["control"]]), lfcThreshold = 0.5, pAdjustMethod = "BH", alpha = 0.01)
  volcanoPlot(res, alpha = 0.01, lfc = 0.5)
  return(res)
})
````

## Other plots

Pulling DE miRNAs ids
```{r}
resultsNames <- resultsList %>% 
  map(as.data.frame) %>% 
  map(rownames_to_column, "id") %>% 
  map(~ mutate(.x, sig = ifelse(is.na(padj),"ns",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange > 0.5, "up",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange < -0.5, "dn","ns"))))) %>%
  map(~ split(.x, f=.x$sig)) %>%
  map(~ map(.x, pull, "id")) %>%
  map(discard_at, at = "ns") %>% 
  purrr::transpose(.names = c("up","dn"))
```

### Heatmaps of DE miRNAs

These heatmaps are from non-model-aware vst-normalized expression values

```{r}
annotDE <- resultsNames %>%
  map(map, as.data.frame) %>%
  map(bind_rows, .id = "Comparison") %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "DE") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(id = `.x[[i]]`) %>% 
  left_join(annotRow, by = "id") %>%
  split(., f = .$Comparison) %>% 
  map(dplyr::select, -Comparison) %>% 
  map(remove_rownames) %>%
  map(column_to_rownames,"id")


iwalk(annotDE, function(a,n){
  if(nrow(a) == 1){
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),] %>% 
      t() %>% 
      as.matrix()
    rownames(mat) <- rownames(a)
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 labels_col = samples$StageType,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  } else {
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),]
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                 labels_col = samples$StageType,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  }
})
```

### Counts of DE miRNAs

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
dat <- resultsNames %>% 
  map(~ map(.x, function(l){ 
    k <- length(intersect(l,mature_known))
    v <- length(intersect(l,mature_variant))
    n <- length(l) - k - v
    return(data.frame(Type = c("known","variant","novel_P"), Counts = c(k,v,n)))
    })) %>% 
  map(bind_rows, .id = "Comparisons") %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "DE") %>% 
  mutate(DE = factor(DE, levels = c("up","dn")),
         Type = factor(Type, levels = c("known", "variant", "novel_P")))

ggplot(dat, aes(x=DE, y=Counts, fill=Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Comparisons)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  c("known" = "#0F5B71", "variant" = "#EEC06B", "novel_P" = "#CD2932")) +
  ggtitle("DE miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()
```

### Jaccard Index

Jaccard Index is count of intersection divide by count of the union. This will normalize by the number of members in each set
```{r}
dat <- c(
  setNames(resultsNames[["up"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["up"]]), "Up")),
  setNames(resultsNames[["dn"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["dn"]]), "Down"))) %>% 
  discard_at(., at = (map_dbl(., length) == 0))

mat1 <- matrix(data=0,nrow=length(dat),ncol=length(dat),dimnames = list(names(dat),names(dat)))
mat2 <- matrix(data=0,nrow=length(dat),ncol=length(dat),dimnames = list(names(dat),names(dat)))

for(i in 1:length(dat)){
  for(j in 1:length(dat)){
    rn <- rownames(mat1)[i]
    cn <- colnames(mat1)[j]
    
    nIntersect <- intersect(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    nUnion <- union(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    
    mat1[i,j] <- length(nIntersect)/length(nUnion)
    mat2[i,j] <- length(intersect(nIntersect,c(mature_known, mature_variant)))/length(intersect(nUnion,c(mature_known, mature_variant)))
    }
}

pheatmap(mat1,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = T,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         breaks = seq(0, 0.5, length.out = 101),
         main = "Jaccard index of DE miRNAs")

pheatmap(mat2,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = T,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         breaks = seq(0, 0.5, length.out = 101),
         main = "Jaccard index of known/variant of known DE miRNAs")
```

Remove SE_7 and SE_8
```{r}
lowQual <- c("PabK14-03SM_SR1","PabK14-03RO_SR2","Pab738_2_FMG_MIR1")
sel <- setdiff(samples$sampleName[samples$Stage %in% paste0("S",1:6)],lowQual)
samples <- samples[samples$sampleName %in% sel,]
```

collapse all reads from second tier to Unaligned
```{r}
kept <- intersect(unique(c(names(mature_plant),mature_known,mature_variant)),read_lines(here("data/analysis/results/repChecked.txt")))

countk <- read_tsv(here("data/analysis/results/bowtie/count_DE.txt"), show_col_types = F) %>%
```

```{r}
vst <- assay(vsd)
vst <- vst - min(vst)

boxplot(split(t(sizeFactors(dds)),dds$StageType),las=2,
        main="Sequencing libraries size factor by Stage")
```

## DE results and violin plots

Here I will loop over all comparisons. The results will be filtered based on a FDR threshold of 0.01 and a minimum log2FC of 0.5.
````{r, message=FALSE}
resultsList <- map(comp, function(c){
  dds$StageType <- relevel(dds$StageType, ref = c[["control"]])
  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast=c("StageType",c[["treatment"]],c[["control"]]), lfcThreshold = 0.5, pAdjustMethod = "BH", alpha = 0.01)
  volcanoPlot(res, alpha = 0.01, lfc = 0.5)
  return(res)
})
````

## Other plots

Pulling DE miRNAs ids
```{r}
resultsNames <- resultsList %>% 
  map(as.data.frame) %>% 
  map(rownames_to_column, "id") %>% 
  map(~ mutate(.x, sig = ifelse(is.na(padj),"ns",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange > 0.5, "up",
                         ifelse(padj < 0.01 & log2FoldChange < -0.5, "dn","ns"))))) %>%
  map(~ split(.x, f=.x$sig)) %>%
  map(~ map(.x, pull, "id")) %>%
  map(discard_at, at = "ns") %>% 
  purrr::transpose(.names = c("up","dn"))
```

### Heatmaps of DE miRNAs

These heatmaps are from non-model-aware vst-normalized expression values

```{r}
annotDE <- resultsNames %>%
  map(map, as.data.frame) %>%
  map(bind_rows, .id = "Comparison") %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "DE") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(id = `.x[[i]]`) %>% 
  left_join(annotRow, by = "id") %>%
  split(., f = .$Comparison) %>% 
  map(dplyr::select, -Comparison) %>% 
  map(remove_rownames) %>%
  map(column_to_rownames,"id")


iwalk(annotDE, function(a,n){
  if(nrow(a) == 1){
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),] %>% 
      t() %>% 
      as.matrix()
    rownames(mat) <- rownames(a)
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 cluster_rows = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 labels_col = samples$StageType,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  } else {
    mat <- vst[rownames(vst) %in% rownames(a),]
    
    hm <- pheatmap(mat,
                 color = viridis(20),
                 annotation_col = annotCol,
                 annotation_row = a,
                 annotation_colors = anncol,
                 border_color = NA,
                 cluster_cols = FALSE,
                 show_rownames = FALSE,
                 clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                 labels_col = samples$StageType,
                 angle_col = 90,
                 legend = TRUE,
                 main = paste0("non-modelaware vst: ", n))
    hm
  }
})
```

### Counts of DE miRNAs

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
dat <- resultsNames %>% 
  map(~ map(.x, function(l){ 
    k <- length(intersect(l,mature_known))
    v <- length(intersect(l,mature_variant))
    n <- length(l) - k - v
    return(data.frame(Type = c("known","variant","novel_P"), Counts = c(k,v,n)))
    })) %>% 
  map(bind_rows, .id = "Comparisons") %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "DE") %>% 
  mutate(DE = factor(DE, levels = c("up","dn")),
         Type = factor(Type, levels = c("known", "variant", "novel_P")))

ggplot(dat, aes(x=DE, y=Counts, fill=Type)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(Comparisons)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  c("known" = "#0F5B71", "variant" = "#EEC06B", "novel_P" = "#CD2932")) +
  ggtitle("DE miRNAs") +
  theme_bw()
```

### Jaccard Index

Jaccard Index is count of intersection divide by count of the union. This will normalize by the number of members in each set
```{r}
dat <- c(
  setNames(resultsNames[["up"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["up"]]), "Up")),
  setNames(resultsNames[["dn"]],paste(names(resultsNames[["dn"]]), "Down"))) %>% 
  discard_at(., at = (map_dbl(., length) == 0))

mat1 <- matrix(data=0,nrow=length(dat),ncol=length(dat),dimnames = list(names(dat),names(dat)))
mat2 <- matrix(data=0,nrow=length(dat),ncol=length(dat),dimnames = list(names(dat),names(dat)))

for(i in 1:length(dat)){
  for(j in 1:length(dat)){
    rn <- rownames(mat1)[i]
    cn <- colnames(mat1)[j]
    
    nIntersect <- intersect(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    nUnion <- union(dat[[rn]],dat[[cn]])
    
    mat1[i,j] <- length(nIntersect)/length(nUnion)
    mat2[i,j] <- length(intersect(nIntersect,c(mature_known, mature_variant)))/length(intersect(nUnion,c(mature_known, mature_variant)))
    }
}

pheatmap(mat1,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = T,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         breaks = seq(0, 0.5, length.out = 101),
         main = "Jaccard index of DE miRNAs")

pheatmap(mat2,
         cluster_rows = F,
         cluster_cols = F,
         display_numbers = T,
         number_format = "%.2f",
         breaks = seq(0, 0.5, length.out = 101),
         main = "Jaccard index of known/variant of known DE miRNAs")
```
